title: 航空制御工学
subtitle: Aircraft Control  Engineering
educationalGoal:
As represented by FBW aircraft, flight control is an essential technology for modern aircraft.
In Aircraft Control Engineering, students will learn control technology and learn the basics of flight control law design/analysis.
advice:
Students will begin by learning the Laplace transform, transfer functions, block diagrams, etc., which are indispensable for control technology.
Next, students will learn pole/zero placement, frequency response, and transient response, which are indispensable for understanding control characteristics.
Finally, students will learn about actual flight control systems through examples.
requiredKnowledge:
Acquisition of Dynamics of Flight
Sufficient skill in mathematics and physics

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain the contrast between time domain motion and Laplace transform domain characteristics.
Be able to express a dynamic system by Laplace transform and transfer function and explain pole & zeros.
Be able to find the transient response from the transfer function and explain the relation between pole & zeros.
Be able to draw board diagrams and vector trajectories and also determine whether the system is stable or not.
Be able to determine the transfer function with feedback and draw outlines of the root locus

achievementLevels.ideal:
(1) Be able to construct CAS- (control augmentation system) level control laws at the block diagram level
(2) Be able to determine on a technical basis each parameter of the control law for the mathematical model of the aircraft motion to be controlled
achievementLevels.standard:
(1) Be able to construct SAS- (stability augmentation system) level control laws at the block diagram level
(2) Be able to determine on a technical basis each parameter of the control law for the mathematical model of the aircraft motion to be controlled

              As represented by FBW aircraft, flight control is an essential technology for modern aircraft.
In Aircraft Control Engineering, students will learn control technology and learn the basics of flight control law design/analysis.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              Students will begin by learning the Laplace transform, transfer functions, block diagrams, etc., which are indispensable for control technology.
Next, students will learn pole/zero placement, frequency response, and transient response, which are indispensable for understanding control characteristics.
Finally, students will learn about actual flight control systems through examples.
